prompt.text:
Implement `Solution.java` with a public final class `Solution` containing an in-memory article catalog.

Expose these public static nested records:
- `Article(long id, String title, List<Long> contributorIds, List<Long> topicIds)`
- `Catalog(Map<Long, String> contributors, Map<Long, String> topics, Map<Long, Article> articles)`

Expose these public static methods:
- `Article create(Catalog catalog, Article article)`
- `Article read(Catalog catalog, long articleId)`
- `Article update(Catalog catalog, long articleId, String title, List<Long> contributorIds, List<Long> topicIds)`
- `boolean delete(Catalog catalog, long articleId)`

Rules:
- Every argument must be non-null. IDs must be positive, titles must contain at least one non-whitespace character, and relationship lists must be non-empty.
- Lists must contain positive, unique IDs in encounter order. Every referenced contributor and topic must exist in the catalog.
- Invalid values or missing relationships cause `IllegalArgumentException`. Creating a duplicate article causes `IllegalStateException`. Reading or updating an absent article causes `NoSuchElementException`.
- `create` and `update` must store and return defensive immutable copies. Later mutation of caller-owned lists must not affect stored articles.
- `update` replaces all mutable article fields while preserving its ID.
- `delete` returns `true` only when an article was removed. Deleting an absent ID returns `false`.
- Do not mutate contributor or topic maps. Article ordering follows the supplied map implementation.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
